b2-17-01.title: Communicative Challenge: What Ana Said
b2-17-01.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks what a colleague of yours said about the report. She said that she had already finished it and that she would send it the next day.
b2-17-01.prompt: Tell Meg what your colleague said about the report.
cues: Say what she said she had already done
Say what she said she would do the next day
b2-17-01.target: Mi compañera dijo que ya había terminado el informe y que lo enviaría al día siguiente.
b2-17-01.english: My colleague said that she had already finished the report and that she would send it the next day.
b2-17-01.canDo: I can report what someone said and move the verb back (dijo que tenía, había llegado, llegaría).

b2-17-02.title: Communicative Challenge: What the Teacher Asked
b2-17-02.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks what your teacher asked you at the end of the class. She asked whether you had finished the exercise and when you would hand in the work.
b2-17-02.prompt: Tell Carlos what the teacher asked you.
cues: Report her yes/no question about the exercise
Report her question about when you would hand in the work
b2-17-02.target: La profesora me preguntó si había terminado el ejercicio y cuándo entregaría el trabajo.
b2-17-02.english: The teacher asked me whether I had finished the exercise and when I would hand in the work.
b2-17-02.canDo: I can report a yes/no question with si and an information question with its question word after a past verb.

b2-17-03.title: Communicative Challenge: What My Boss Asked
b2-17-03.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks why you wrote to a client. Your boss asked you to write to him and to send him the report.
b2-17-03.prompt: Tell Meg what your boss asked you to do.
cues: Say what your boss asked you to do first
Say the second thing your boss asked
b2-17-03.target: Mi jefe me pidió que escribiera a un cliente y que le enviara el informe.
b2-17-03.english: My boss asked me to write to a client and to send him the report.
b2-17-03.canDo: I can report an order or a request with que + the imperfect subjunctive, also when it was asked as a question.

b2-17-04.title: Communicative Challenge: What Ana Told Me
b2-17-04.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks what a classmate of yours told you when she phoned from Lima last week. She said that she had arrived in Lima the day before and had a meeting there that day.
b2-17-04.prompt: Tell Carlos what your classmate told you.
cues: Say when she had arrived in Lima
Say what she had that day and where
b2-17-04.target: Mi compañera me dijo que el día anterior había llegado a Lima y que aquel día tenía una reunión allí.
b2-17-04.english: My classmate told me that the day before she had arrived in Lima and that that day she had a meeting there.
b2-17-04.canDo: I can change time and place words when I retell what someone said (hoy becomes aquel día, aquí becomes allí).

b2-17-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Luis Waits
b2-17-05.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks you to continue a short story: Luis is waiting at the station for a friend who is late. Show what Luis thinks as a question in the narrator’s voice, without a verb like pensó.
b2-17-05.prompt: Tell the next lines of the story.
cues: Say that Luis looked at the clock
Give his thought as a question
Add what he thinks about his friend being late
b2-17-05.target: Luis miró el reloj. ¿Dónde estaba su amigo? Otra vez llegaba tarde.
b2-17-05.english: Luis looked at the clock. Where was his friend? He was late again.
b2-17-05.canDo: I can spot free indirect speech in a story: a character’s question, doubt or exclamation told in the narrator’s past tense.

b2-17-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Class Yesterday
b2-17-consolidation.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks what your teacher said about the novel in class yesterday. She asked whether you had read the first chapter, and she asked you to read the second one by the next day.
b2-17-consolidation.prompt: Tell Carlos what the teacher asked.
cues: Report her yes/no question about the first chapter
Report her request about the second chapter
Say by when she asked you to read it
b2-17-consolidation.target: La profesora preguntó si habíamos leído el primer capítulo y nos pidió que leyéramos el segundo al día siguiente.
b2-17-consolidation.english: The teacher asked whether we had read the first chapter and asked us to read the second one the next day.
b2-17-consolidation.canDo: I can report statements, questions and requests after a past verb.
